name: finreg_esma_json_and_code_benchmark_synthetic_data
description: A synthetic dataset of ESMA-style financial regulatory JSON records and accompanying code designed to benchmark models on regulatory data parsing and code-related tasks. It is intended to test models' ability to understand regulatory schemas, extract required fields, and generate or validate code snippets and structured outputs that comply with regulatory formats. The synthetic nature enables controlled evaluation while avoiding disclosure of real sensitive data.
reputation: Provided by the FINOSfoundation for the fintech/regtech community; niche usage but potentially useful for compliance-focused model evaluation.
